open_with: Open by inviting Hartono to walk through how he's been thinking about the family wealth pool he's building separate from the mine — genuinely engaging him as the person now steering treasury decisions. Ask what's on his mind for that pool right now (new allocations, timing, goals) rather than starting with a portfolio review. Let him set the frame; then naturally connect it to the diversification conversation he opened on 2026-01-08, treating it as his own thread to pick back up rather than something you're reintroducing.
do_not_lead_with: Don't open with the Indonesia energy concentration, the margin breach, or the fact that the portfolio added to the position 97 days after he asked to diversify away from it. All three are legitimate concerns, but leading with any of them puts him in a defensive position about the legacy holding — and any perceived push to reduce it reads to the family as a signal, which isn't your call to trigger in a first exchange. Surface the concentration and the reversal only after he's re-engaged the diversification topic himself, and frame it as helping him execute on his own stated intention rather than flagging a problem he created or missed.
one_number: 45.0% of total wealth concentrated in Indonesia energy (across 2 positions, 2 instrument types) — have this ready to ground the diversification discussion once he reopens it.
